# Interconnect_Neuromorphic_Integration

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-23

## Definition
The integration of neuromorphic processing elements directly into the interconnect fabric of a computing system. Shifts computation into the network itself, reducing data movement and latency in topology-centric architectures.
